payload.text: Convention cross-field consistency invariant (docs/CONVENTIONS.md PremiumStyle⇔DeltaConvention coupling): ConventionRecord::is_consistent is a pure total predicate asserting self.premium_style.is_premium_adjusted() == self.is_delta_premium_adjusted() — i.e. a record is consistent exactly when its premium style and its delta convention agree on premium-adjustment. const fn, no writes/allocation/IO; deterministic. Self-invalidates if either underlying mapping or this coupling changes (WRITES gate).
